title: General plus points and standout advantages
summary: This topic mostly captures isolated mentions of perceived plus points such as xDrive, service intervals, suspension setup, and overall satisfaction, but many fragments are too short to identify a clear sentiment or consistent subject.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car overall and specifically describe xDrive as a meaningful advantage.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are very short or incomplete, which limits confident sentiment interpretation.
